name: Introduction and overview — Slava-class Cruiser — ship record
title: Introduction and overview — Slava-class Cruiser
description: Introduction and overview of the Slava-class Cruiser: What this class is, its role in the fleet, and why it matters in naval history. The Soviet Slava class — three completed — are guided-missile cruisers built around sixteen huge P-500/P-1000 anti-ship missiles in deck launchers. The Moskva, the class lead ship and Black Sea Fleet flagship, was sunk by Ukrainian missiles in 2022. The survivors serve Russia's Northern and Pacific fleets. Baseline facts: Soviet/Russian missile cruiser; 3 completed; 16 heavy anti-ship missiles; Moskva sunk 2022..
